$comment: The licences a package in the explorer's resolved tree may carry (pnpm licenses list). It follows gate/licences.txt, the one SPDX allowlist: allowed holds only ids that list holds as plain ids (a test checks it), and adds is the <package> adds <id> form, one package one id, never every package. It is a second file only because gate/licences.txt reads Go module paths; an npm name is not one.

argparse.reason: build tooling (eslint), and the command-line script of markdown-it, which the library never imports; a bundle does not carry it

caniuse-lite.reason: data, attribution only; build tooling, not shipped

@ibm/plex-mono.reason: a font family vendored as woff2 under packages/tokens/fonts, not installed; shipped, with its notice

@ibm/plex-sans.reason: a font family vendored as woff2 under packages/tokens/fonts, not installed; shipped, with its notice

language-subtag-registry.reason: public-domain dedication; data of a lint rule, not shipped

type-fest.reason: dual-licensed, MIT is allowed; reached by msw, a test-only devDependency, not shipped
